title: Modern and Contemporary Art Icons
description: An in-depth introduction to the life and career of modern or contemporary art icons such as Joseph Beuys, Barbara Hepworth, Andy Warhol, Georgia O'Keeffe, Pablo Picasso, Varvara Stepanova or Marina Abramovic. Studied artists vary.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of AHVS 260, HA 260.
